content.user_title: Apply Professional Themes to Any Artifact
content.value_statement: Inconsistent colors and fonts make presentations and documents look unfinished. This skill applies curated themes or creates a custom theme for consistent styling.
actual_capabilities: Shows a ten-theme PDF showcase for visual selection.
Provides exact hex colors and font pairings for each preset.
Applies a selected theme consistently across an existing artifact.
Recommends themes for presentations, reports, documents, and HTML pages.
Creates a custom color and font theme from a user description.
limitations: Does not include scripts that directly edit presentation or document files.
Uses font families that may not be installed in every environment.
Does not define detailed component layouts, charts, or illustration styles.
Custom themes depend on the quality and specificity of user guidance.

use_cases.title: Restyle Executive Slides
use_cases.description: Apply a calm, readable preset to an existing leadership deck while preserving content and structure.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Reports
use_cases.description: Use one color and typography system across recurring reports for a consistent professional identity.

use_cases.title: Create a Campaign Theme
use_cases.description: Generate a custom palette and font pairing from a campaign brief, then apply it across HTML and document assets.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Preset Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the theme showcase, then help me choose a professional theme for a quarterly business review. Wait for my selection before applying it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Select a suitable preset with guided support.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Selected Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply Ocean Depths to this presentation. Use its specified colors and fonts consistently, preserve the content, and verify contrast on every slide.
prompt_templates.scenario: Restyle an existing artifact with a chosen preset.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Themes for an Audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Arctic Frost, Modern Minimalist, and Tech Innovation for a healthcare technology investor deck. Recommend one based on readability, tone, and audience fit.
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate several presets against audience requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Create and Apply a Custom Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a premium climate analytics brand. Define a name, four-color palette, header font, body font, usage guidance, and contrast rules. Show it for approval before applying it to the artifact.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a complete theme from an advanced creative brief.

output_examples.input: I need a trustworthy theme for a financial consulting deck.
output_examples.output: Recommended theme: Ocean Depths. It uses deep navy, teal, seafoam, and cream with DejaVu Sans typography for a calm professional tone.

output_examples.input: Create a theme for a modern botanical skincare launch.
output_examples.output: Theme name: Glasshouse. Use deep leaf green, clear glass blue, soft white, and coral accents with an elegant serif header and clean sans-serif body.

best_practices: Review the theme showcase before selecting a preset.
Confirm the intended audience, medium, and accessibility needs.
Check contrast, font availability, and consistency after applying the theme.
anti_patterns: Do not mix colors or fonts from multiple themes without a clear system.
Do not apply a theme before the user confirms the selection.
Do not change content hierarchy solely to match a visual theme.

faq.question: Which artifacts can this skill style?
faq.answer: It can guide styling for slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts when the active tool can edit those formats.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes with named colors, hex values, font pairings, and suggested uses.

faq.question: Can it create a custom theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a named palette and font pairing from a description, then present the theme for approval.

faq.question: Will it rewrite my content?
faq.answer: It focuses on colors and typography. Request content or structural edits separately when they are needed.

faq.question: Are the specified fonts always available?
faq.answer: No. Verify DejaVu or Free font availability and choose suitable substitutes when the target environment lacks them.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee accessibility?
faq.answer: It directs the agent to preserve contrast and readability, but users should still review the final artifact for accessibility.
